status: Review-only step 2 geometry. No application code/configuration or sensor TF applied.
convention: T_A_B maps coordinates B into A; Point-LIO needs p_imu=extrinsic_R*p_lidar+extrinsic_T.

proposed_measurement_tf.basis: Recovered exact conversion between vendor raw and body cloud streams, independently validated across captures/postures. Not manufacturer-specified physical mount geometry.

point_lio_body_imu_extrinsics.basis: Compose vendor raw->body coordinate conversion with inverse of the unchanged developer body-IMU mount; do not use LiDAR internal IMU offset.

caveats: Exact conversion agreement is numerical stream consistency, not micrometre physical placement accuracy.
Absolute physical body-frame/URDF correspondence is assumed from vendor body frame labels and developer geometry.
Selected body IMU already has developer TF; invalid raw LiDAR IMU utlidar_imu is not selected and no guessed TF is proposed for it.
New raw-cloud measurement edge requires user approval before publication.
